currency_found: SGD for the audited financial statements (Consolidated Income Statement, Balance Sheet, Cash Flows all in S$'000). CapitaLand India Trust's functional currency is INR but presentation/reporting currency is SGD; distributions are in SGD. Per-property valuations & purchase prices in the Portfolio section are disclosed in BOTH INR (Rs million, primary) and SGD.

currency_by_table.properties: market_valuation & purchase_price stored in SGD (presentation ccy, matches audited FS and portfolio total S$3,705.5m); original_value/original_currency = INR local figure (audit trail); purchase_price_local/_currency = INR.
currency_by_table.property_transactions: SGD row currency; INR figures preserved in raw/valuation_currency.

cash_flow_atoms.basis: All from Consolidated Statement of Cash Flows (pages 141-142), S$'000 x1000. dep_pe = 'Depreciation of plant and equipment and right-of-use assets' 2,239. fv_cf_signed = 'Fair value gain on investment properties and IPUC' (331,791) as deducted in operating CF = -331,791. finance_costs = gross finance-costs note (page 135) 90,305. capex_sum = IP-related investing outflows: additions to IPUC & IP 198,613 + advance payment on IP/IPUC/P&E 356 + net cash outflow from acquisition of subsidiaries 33,393 + purchase of plant & equipment 4,684 = 237,046 (July-2026 rule: includes acquisitions). Excludes intangibles 12,766 and long-term receivables.

derived_financial.depreciation_basis: dep_pe(2,239) + fv_cf_signed(-331,791); negative because FY2024 recognised a large non-cash IP fair-value GAIN
derived_financial.ffo_basis: net_income(458,030)+depreciation(-329,552)-net_property_sales(0); FFO below net income in a revaluation-gain year (correct)

data_provenance.basis: FY2024 was a tax BENEFIT of S$666k ('Income tax benefit (expenses)' +666 on the Income Statement, page 135). Stored NEGATIVE so net_income = pretax_income - income_taxes = 457,364 - (-666) = 458,030.
Non-controlling interests share of net profit 19,255 ('000); NEGATIVE per convention (deduction to reach unitholders 438,775).
Business trust with no perpetual securities in issue.
EPU note 9: 'Weighted average number of units outstanding during the year' 1,336,241 ('000); basic and diluted EPU both 32.84 cents so diluted = basic.
No investment-property disposals completed in FY2024. CyberVale & CyberPearl classified held-for-sale at 31 Dec 2024 but not yet sold; the S$331.8m fair-value gain is a revaluation, not a sale.
Portfolio valued at Rs232.5 billion = S$3,705.5 million as at 31 Dec 2024 (Savills), page 23-24.
Gearing ratio 38.5% per Financial Review/capital management (page 22, 24). FS note (page 116) rounds to 39%.
Interest coverage ratio (Adjusted EBITDA/Interest expenses) 2.6 times, page 22.
'Income available for distribution' S$101,492k (Distribution Statement, page 137). 10% retained -> 'Income to be distributed' S$91,343k = distribution_paid.
Weighted average debt maturity not disclosed as a single headline figure in the FY2024 report; debt maturity profile shown only as a bar chart. Left null.
